engine.name: mtg-kernel
engine.build: cargo build --release --locked -p mtg-kernel (Windows x86_64 MSVC, rust 1.94.1, rust-lld linker)
engine.host: HaleysPC, under a host_slots claim of 3 cores

gorge_ar8_smoke.matchup: c12 vs gorge-ar8, 8 pairs (16 games), unrated

v4_visibility.what_it_tests: At every decision of neutral private-support games on the eight board decks, the acting seat's V4 boundary and x_kernel_flat_v4 encoding are unchanged when the search sampler redeterminizes every hidden card the engine's knowledge tables mark as unknown to that seat; and every place one player learned hidden cards of the other (library look or reveal, hand reveal, library reorder revealed to the opponent) is a reviewed site marked in the source. It is a consistency check against the engine's own knowledge tables plus a pinned enumeration of reveal sites, not a proof against a fact the tables wrongly mark as known.
v4_visibility.coverage: The audit exercised 6 of the 21 marked library-reveal calls and 8 of the 35 marked hand-reveal calls; the rest rest on the static enumeration reviewed in mtg-kernel #462 and #476. Every current library reorder reveals only to its owner.

rule: Rerun every audit above on the pinned binaries, and replace this receipt, whenever the engine behind this board changes. The board rates no games on an engine without a passing receipt.
